description: Atlas des Zones Inondables (AZI - PACA) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by paca.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The Atlas of Flood Zones are documents of knowledge of flood phenomena likely to occur by overflowing rivers. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Atlas of Flood Zones (AZI - PACA)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2009-03-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
